race.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Several will have later-season targets in mind, and the vote goes to OUR GUIDE , who finished third in a strong renewal of Silver Trophy last month. Heather Honey is also fancied to go well with a run under her belt, while Lihyan needs a second look at bigger prices. Harbour Lake , Kikijo and Red Risk have all gone well fresh previously. OUR GUIDE (IRE) HEATHER HONEY LIHYAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Our Guide (7/2), French Ship (6/1), Walden (6/1), The Egyptian Ginge (7/1), Idem (10/1), Heather Honey (12/1), Harbour Lake (12/1), Lihyan (14/1), Lord Snootie (14/1), Park Princess (14/1), Red Risk (16/1), Kikijo (16/1), Deep Cave (20/1), Divilabother (25/1)
